unscored_labels.label: Laughter
unscored_labels.reason: Four voiced bursts at a steady f0 (176-204 Hz) are separated by dips of 17-20 dB: 7.35-7.65, 7.75-7.90, 8.05-8.15, 8.35-8.65 s (50 ms envelope, ~0.3 s spacing), which fits a laugh or a rapid 'ha-ha' but equally fits breath-grouped speech by the same speaker, whose f0 is ~200 Hz just before (6.7-7.15 s). After 8.65 s the clip is near silent (-44 to -51 dB, a pause) until a 0.1 s blip at 9.15-9.25 s, then silence to 10.1 s. The labelled span 7.8-9.2 therefore starts 0.45 s after the first burst and runs 0.55 s past the last sustained energy; 38% of its frames are below -43 dB. Onset has no acoustic change at 7.8 s (percentile 0.05); the nearest big change is the 8.65 s fall (-13.6 dB).
